name: Suah
overview: Suah is a male member of the tribe of Asher, identified specifically as the son of Zophah. Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture provides no further information about his life or role. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical in nature.
namesAndTitles: The name Suah is a proper name meaning possibly 'offal, dung, viscera,' reflecting a Hebrew root. There is no indication that this name was given by God, and no additional titles or names are recorded for him.
familyAndRelationships: Suah is explicitly recorded as the son of Zophah, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Scripture does not provide any further family connections or relationships for Suah beyond this.
scriptureSignificance: Suah's significance lies in his place within the genealogical record of the tribe of Asher, as noted in 1 Chronicles 7:36. This genealogy serves to document the descendants of Asher, contributing to the preservation of Israel's tribal history. Though Suah himself does not have a recorded narrative or deeds, his mention supports the biblical emphasis on lineage and God's faithfulness to His covenant people.
